raw.rationale: Prochlorperazine is a phenothiazine dopamine antagonist with additional off-target activity at sigma-1, 5-HT, alpha-adrenergic, and histamine receptors; at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is likely broadly cytotoxic rather than selectively lineage-dependent, and PRISM/other screens do not support strong lineage-selective killing. Any apparent selectivity would most plausibly reflect general sensitivity of hematologic or CNS lines, but none of the listed lineages has a well-established DRD-driven dependency.
